title: Current-Main Capability Service Realisation Map
authorityBoundary: This artefact maps current repository semantic contracts to current-main local service, API, command, workflow, state, data, auth, audit, telemetry, validator, and proof evidence where such evidence exists. It does not create runtime product readiness, UI readiness, generated SDK readiness, public API readiness, staging, production, deployment, live-provider, compliance, monetisation, app store, or human-acceptance claims.

validatorRequirements.requirement: Every semantic contract has exactly one current-main capability-service row.
Rows preserve traceability and implementation authority boundaries.
Rows fail closed on stale current-main or generated-client freshness.
Rows fail closed on proof, generated report, generated client, SDK, UI, public API, or readiness overclaims.

plantedDefectCoverage.failureShape: implementation path present without semantic route authority
